statement.p: A connected graph with 12 vertices contains 17 edges. Without knowing which particular graph this is, what is the smallest and largest possible number of edges you can remove to get a spanning tree?

solution.p: Every spanning tree must still contain 12 vertices. Since it is a tree, it will have 12-1 = 11 edges.
Thus we must remove 6 edges to get a spanning tree.
